question.text: Will the World Health Organization prequalify moxidectin before December 15, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, before December 15, 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) adds moxidectin to its prequalification (PQ) [list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products), according to official WHO announcements or other [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/help/faq/#definitions). If this does not occur before that date, this question resolves as **No**.
question.fine_print:
Note that this question resolves **Yes** only if moxidectin achieves PQ approval for the treatment of onchocerciasis. If moxidectin achieves PQ approval for another indication, but not onchocerciasis, this question resolves as **No**.

Although Medicines Development for Global Health (MDGH) is developing moxidectin for potential WHO PQ, this question resolves regardless of which entity achieves the PQ.

research:
**Bottom line:** As of 2026-10-31, moxidectin is not on the WHO prequalified medicines list. I found no public sign that a dossier has been submitted or accepted, and the WHO treatment guideline that PQ is expected to follow does not appear to have been published. About six weeks remain before the 2026-12-15 deadline.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-31 (checked today): The full CSV export of the WHO list of prequalified finished pharmaceutical products shows 17 neglected tropical disease (NT) entries, NT002 to NT022. None is moxidectin. The newest is NT022, Praziquantel 600mg (Mepro), prequalified 19 Jun 2026. NT021 Albendazole and NT020 Azithromycin were prequalified 19 Dec 2025. The only ivermectin entries are NT007 and NT009, which are generics. No reference numbers above NT022 appear, and NT018 is missing from the export. [WHO PQ CSV](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products/export?field_sf_subtype_target_id=All&field_sf_therapeutic_areas_target_id=All&field_sf_pdt_copackaging_target_id=All&field_sf_cdt_type_target_id=All&field_sf_assessment_procedure_target_id=All&field_sf_basis_of_listing_target_id=All&order=title&sort=desc&_format=csv)
- Searching the list's web page for "moxidectin" returned no matching entry. [WHO PQ list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles the question.
- I could not find any public record (from WHO, MDGH or the press) of a moxidectin PQ dossier being submitted, screened or under assessment.
- 2025 (EML review): WHO reviewers said moxidectin was "not yet prequalified, but engagement with WHO PQ team is ongoing," and that PQ was expected to follow WHO treatment guidelines, then due in "early 2026." [EML review](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/expert-reviews/a.20_moxidectin_review1.pdf?sfvrsn=7d28be3e_1)
- MDGH's EML proposal said it was "considering applying for WHO prequalification via the full route." [MDGH proposal](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/addition-of-new-medicines/a.20_moxidectin.pdf?sfvrsn=811cf48b_6)
- I found no evidence that the WHO onchocerciasis treatment guideline covering moxidectin has been published in 2026.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-12: MDGH's latest news item is about a dovramilast leprosy trial. MDGH has posted nothing on moxidectin PQ. [MDGH news](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news)
- 2026-09-29: MDGH enrolled the first participant in a Phase 3 trial of moxidectin for lymphatic filariasis in Fiji. [MDGH news](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news)
- 2026-05-07: Healthbeat reported that "Countries and the WHO still have to review the data and issue guidance." About 120,000 people in Ghana received moxidectin last year. Nature coverage likewise describes "a long permissions process with the WHO." [Healthbeat](https://www.healthbeat.org/2026/05/07/global-health-checkup-moxidectin-river-blindness-ai-insurance-hantavirus-cruise/), [Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/d44148-026-00110-2)
- 2026-04-06: WHO PQ's guidance index lists "Notes on the design of bioequivalence study: moxidectin" with this date. An earlier version was dated 24 Oct 2024. These notes mainly guide generic makers. [WHO PQ guidance](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/who-medicines-prequalification-guidance)
- 2025-09-08: Moxidectin was added to the WHO Essential Medicines Lists (adult and children) as an alternative to ivermectin. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/medicines-development-for-global-health-announces-inclusion-of-moxidectin-on-world-health-organization-essential-medicines-lists)
- 2025-02-20: The US FDA extended approval to children aged 4 and older. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/u-s-fda-expands-indication-for-moxidectin-to-treat-river-blindness-in-patients-as-young-as-four)
- 2024-12-12: Ghana's FDA approved moxidectin. [WHO](https://www.who.int/news/item/12-12-2024-moxidectin-approved-by-the-ghana-food-and-drugs-authority-a-new-milestone-in-the-fight-against-river-blindness)
- 2024-10-29: WHO published a revised 9th NTD expression of interest (EOI) that added moxidectin, so manufacturers can now apply. [WHO PQ](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/revised-ntd-eoi-published)

## 4. Base rates
- The median time to prequalify a finished pharmaceutical product is about 200 days, according to a WHO FAQ quoted on a Metaculus page. With no public sign of a submission, a decision within six weeks would mean an assessment is already well advanced out of public view. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/34283/will-the-world-health-organization-prequalify-moxidectin-before-april-1-2025)
- NT prequalifications are rare and tend to come in clusters. There have been 17 since 2013. Two came on 19 Dec 2025 and one in June 2026, so December listings do happen.
- Two years have passed since moxidectin was added to the EOI (Oct 2024) without a listing.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets that were collected relate to this question.
- GiveWell, at the time of its June 2024 grant, forecast an 80% chance that MDGH gets WHO PQ by the end of 2026. That page was published in Nov 2024 and has not been updated since. The grant needed WHO to invite applications first, which happened in Oct 2024. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- Metaculus "before 2027" question: one search snippet showed 92%, but I could not confirm the current value (the page returned 403) and the figure may be stale. [Metaculus](https://metaculus.com/questions/28395/will-who-prequalify-moxidectin-by-2027)
- The earlier Metaculus question "before April 1, 2025" resolved No; its community forecast was about 15%. Metaculus discussion also cited WHO requiring extra trials. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/34283/will-the-world-health-organization-prequalify-moxidectin-before-april-1-2025)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- A possible WHO PQ batch listing in December. NT020 and NT021 were both listed on 19 Dec 2025, but a similar date this year would fall after the 15 Dec deadline.
- Possible publication of the WHO onchocerciasis treatment guideline, which reviewers saw as coming before PQ.
- MDGH planned a workshop "near the end of 2026" under the GiveWell grant.
- I found no scheduled WHO PQ decision date for moxidectin.

## 1. Resolution source

- 2026-10-31: I fetched the WHO PQ finished-product list (659 entries) and also ran it with a "moxidectin" search parameter. Neither showed a moxidectin entry. The fetch only returned the first 50 rows, all HIV products, so I could not check the whole list or the NTD filter. The page carried an undated "25 Jun, 2026" stamp. [WHO PQ list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products)
- I found no WHO announcement, MDGH press release or news report of moxidectin being prequalified.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing settles the question yet. Moxidectin is not shown as prequalified.
- 2024-10-29: WHO PQ revised its 9th NTD invitation (Expression of Interest, EOI) to include moxidectin. Manufacturers can only file once an EOI covers the product. [WHO PQ](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/revised-ntd-eoi-published)
- 2025-03: Moxidectin was added to WHO's 38th invitation for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). [WHO PQ](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/38th-invitation-active-pharmaceutical-ingredients-apis)
- 2026-04-06: WHO PQ published design notes for moxidectin bioequivalence studies. This is guidance mainly for generic makers, not a listing decision. [WHO PQ guidance](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/who-medicines-prequalification-guidance)
- 2025 EML expert review: moxidectin was "not yet prequalified," talks with the PQ team were "ongoing," and prequalification was "expected to follow the release of WHO treatment guidance." The review also said no WHO onchocerciasis treatment guideline existed. [WHO review](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/expert-reviews/a.20_moxidectin_review1.pdf?sfvrsn=7d28be3e_1)
- The EML proposal said a WHO guideline on moxidectin for onchocerciasis and lymphatic filariasis was expected in early 2026. I found no evidence it has been published. [EML proposal](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/addition-of-new-medicines/a.20_moxidectin.pdf?sfvrsn=811cf48b_6)
- The October 2024 EML application said MDGH was only "considering" applying through the full PQ route. I found no confirmation that a dossier was ever submitted.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-09-29: MDGH enrolled the first participant in a Phase 3 trial of moxidectin for lymphatic filariasis in Fiji. The release does not mention PQ. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/bolt)
- 2026-07-01: MDGH's 2025 Annual Report highlights the EML listing but says nothing about prequalification. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/2025-annual-report)
- 2026-02: Results were posted for MDGH's large safety trial in the Democratic Republic of Congo (NCT04311671). [ClinicalTrials.gov](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04311671)
- 2025-09-08: Moxidectin was added to the WHO adult and child Essential Medicines Lists as an alternative to ivermectin. [MDGH](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news/medicines-development-for-global-health-announces-inclusion-of-moxidectin-on-world-health-organization-essential-medicines-lists)
- 2025-02-20: The US FDA expanded the label to children aged 4 and older. 2025-01-28: Ghana began rolling out the drug. 2024-12-05: Ghana's FDA approved it. [MDGH news](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news), [WHO](https://www.who.int/news/item/12-12-2024-moxidectin-approved-by-the-ghana-food-and-drugs-authority-a-new-milestone-in-the-fight-against-river-blindness)
- Undated: The Metaculus question page says WHO "unexpectedly required extensive extra clinical trials," making near-term PQ uncertain. I could not verify this; the page returned a 403 error. [Metaculus](https://metaculus.com/questions/28395/will-who-prequalify-moxidectin-by-2027)
- The articles supplied from the news API are all about US peptide policy and have nothing to do with this question.

## 4. Base rates

- An earlier Metaculus question, "Will WHO prequalify moxidectin before April 1, 2025?", resolved No. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/34283/will-the-world-health-organization-prequalify-moxidectin-before-april-1-2025)
- 2024-06: GiveWell put an 80% chance on MDGH getting PQ by the end of 2026. That was an internal forecast, and its grant page has had no update since November 2024. [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024)
- Full-route PQ assessments of innovator products usually take about 12 months or more after a dossier is accepted (my general knowledge, not checked for this case). It has now been about 2 years since the EOI with no confirmed filing, which points to a long timeline.

## 5. Other forecasts

- None of the Polymarket or Kalshi prices supplied (Trump pardons, ski resort openings and so on) relate to this question. I found no prediction market on moxidectin.
- Metaculus has a closely related question, "before 2027" (ID 28395). I could not get its community forecast because the page returned a 403 error.
- GiveWell's 2024 internal forecast was 80% by end of 2026. It is old and probably stale.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-12-15

- A WHO onchocerciasis or lymphatic filariasis treatment guideline that includes moxidectin could be published. The 2025 review treated this as a step that comes before PQ.
- WHO PQ adds products to the list continuously, with no fixed meeting dates. A listing could appear at any time, but I found no sign that one is imminent.
- MDGH's GiveWell-funded grant workshop was planned for "near the end of 2026" and might report on progress.
- Overall, I found nothing suggesting a PQ decision is close: no confirmed dossier, no published guideline, and silence in MDGH's 2026 communications.

Sources: [WHO PQ list](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/prequalified/finished-pharmaceutical-products), [WHO PQ EOI](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/revised-ntd-eoi-published), [API invitation](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/news/38th-invitation-active-pharmaceutical-ingredients-apis), [PQ guidance](https://extranet.who.int/prequal/medicines/who-medicines-prequalification-guidance), [EML review](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/expert-reviews/a.20_moxidectin_review1.pdf?sfvrsn=7d28be3e_1), [EML proposal](https://cdn.who.int/media/docs/default-source/2025-eml-expert-committee/addition-of-new-medicines/a.20_moxidectin.pdf?sfvrsn=811cf48b_6), [MDGH news](https://www.medicinesdevelopment.com/news), [GiveWell](https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/medicines-development-for-global-health-moxidectin-who-pre-qualification-grant-june-2024), [Metaculus](https://metaculus.com/questions/28395/will-who-prequalify-moxidectin-by-2027), [TDR](https://tdr.who.int/activities/moxidectin-a-new-drug-for-ntds)

forecasts.reasoning:
**(a) Time left and what Yes requires:** About 6.5 weeks remain, until 2026-12-15. For Yes, WHO must add moxidectin to its prequalified finished pharmaceutical products list for onchocerciasis before that date.

**(b) Status quo:** Moxidectin is not on the list as of 2026-10-31. The newest NT entry is NT022 (praziquantel, June 2026). There is no public sign that a dossier has been submitted or is under assessment. The status quo outcome is No.

**(c) Base rate:** Prequalifying a product that is not already listed takes a median of about 200 days. There is no public evidence of a submission. Products with no visible advanced assessment rarely get listed within a six-week window, probably under 5%. Moxidectin has also sat on the EOI for two years without a listing, and the prior Metaculus question resolved No.

**(d) Evidence:**
- For Yes:
  - GiveWell's June 2024 forecast gave an 80% chance of PQ by the end of 2026.
  - A Metaculus "before 2027" snippet showed 92%, though that figure may be stale.
  - WHO PQ updated its bioequivalence notes for moxidectin on 2026-04-06, which shows ongoing engagement.
  - The EML listing in September 2025 and the stated "ongoing engagement" with the PQ team point the same way.
  - PQ assessments are not always announced publicly.
- For No:
  - The 2025 EML review said PQ was expected to follow the WHO treatment guideline, which has apparently not been published as of October 2026.
  - On 2026-05-07, Healthbeat reported that WHO still had to review the data and issue guidance.
  - MDGH's news through 2026-10-12 says nothing about PQ.
  - Last year's December listings came on Dec 19, which would fall after this deadline.

**(e) Scenarios:**
- No: The guideline is still pending, the PQ assessment (if submitted at all) continues into 2027, and any December batch lands after Dec 15 or does not include moxidectin.
- Yes: MDGH quietly submitted via the full route in late 2025 or early 2026, the assessment concluded, and WHO lists moxidectin in late November or early December alongside a guideline release.

**(f) Adjustment:** I start from a low base rate of about 3-5%, given six weeks and no visible pipeline. I shift slightly upward because the assessment could be happening out of public view, the April 2026 guidance update shows WHO PQ attention, and the stale external forecasts were high. I discount those forecasts heavily because they predate the guideline delays. The Metaculus "before 2027" question differs in timing and is probably stale. The final estimate is about 5%.

Probability: 5%

**(a) Time left and what Yes requires.** About 6.5 weeks remain, from 2026-10-31 to 2026-12-15. For Yes, WHO must add moxidectin to the prequalified finished pharmaceutical products list for onchocerciasis before December 15.

**(b) Status quo.** Moxidectin is not listed. The newest neglected tropical disease (NT) entry is NT022, praziquantel, from June 2026. There is no public sign that a moxidectin dossier is under assessment. If nothing changes, the answer is No.

**(c) Base rate.** Prequalification takes a median of about 200 days, and NT listings are rare: 17 since 2013. For a product with no visible submission, the chance of a listing within any given six-week window is low, roughly 3-8%. The earlier Metaculus question for a nearer deadline also resolved No.

**(d) Strongest evidence.**
- *For Yes:*
  - Moxidectin was added to the WHO expression of interest for NTD products in October 2024.
  - The 2025 Essential Medicines List review said engagement with the PQ team was ongoing.
  - WHO revised its bioequivalence notes for moxidectin on 2026-04-06, which shows WHO PQ is still working on it.
  - GiveWell's 2024 forecast gave 80% for PQ by the end of 2026, and a Metaculus snippet for the "before 2027" question showed 92%. Both may be stale.
  - PQ assessments are confidential, so a submission could be advanced without public notice.
- *For No:*
  - The question was still unresolved as of the 2026-10-31 list check.
  - The WHO treatment guideline, which PQ was expected to follow, has not been published.
  - In May 2026, press coverage described WHO review as still pending.
  - MDGH has said nothing about PQ, and its October news concerns other programs.
  - Last year's December NT batch was listed on December 19, which is after this question's cutoff.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- *No:* The guideline comes out in late 2026 or 2027, and PQ follows months later, in 2027.
- *Yes:* A full-route dossier quietly submitted in 2025 finishes assessment, and WHO lists it in November or early December, possibly alongside a guideline release.

**(f) Moving from the base rate.** I start at about 5%. The stale high forecasts and the confidential pipeline argue for a small upward nudge. The missing guideline, the short window and the timing of December batches argue for staying low. The net effect is to stay at about 5%.

Probability: 5%

(a) About six weeks remain (2026-10-31 to 2026-12-15). For Yes, WHO must add moxidectin to the prequalified finished pharmaceutical products list for onchocerciasis before December 15, 2026.

(b) Status quo: moxidectin is not on the list, so the status quo outcome is No.

(c) Base rate: a full-route PQ assessment takes a median of about 200 days. The abbreviated route via a stringent regulator's approval (the FDA approved moxidectin) is faster, roughly 90 days or more. When there is no public sign of a submission, the chance of a listing within any given six-week window is low, around 5-10%. NT listings are rare, 17 since 2013.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - The 2025 EML review said "engagement with WHO PQ team is ongoing."
  - GiveWell gave an 80% chance of PQ by end-2026, as of mid-2024.
  - A Metaculus snippet showed 92% for "before 2027," though that figure is probably stale.
